RHA_steel.label: Rolled Homogeneous Armour Steel
RHA_steel.cs_source: Cowper & Symonds (1957), J. Mech. Phys. Solids 5(2), 95-107; calibrated for RHA in Børvik et al. (2003)
RHA_steel.jc_source: Johnson & Cook (1983), 7th Int. Symp. Ballistics, 541-547; RHA parameters from Johnson & Cook (1985) Eng. Fract. Mech. 21(1), 31-48

aluminium_7075_T6.label: Aluminium Alloy 7075-T6
aluminium_7075_T6.cs_source: Cowper & Symonds (1957); parameters from T. Børvik et al. (2003) for aluminium alloys
aluminium_7075_T6.jc_source: Johnson & Cook (1983/1985); 7075-T6 parameters from Johnson & Cook (1985) Eng. Fract. Mech. 21(1), 31-48

copper.label: Copper (bullet jacket)
copper.cs_source: Cowper & Symonds (1957); CS parameters estimated, no specific copper calibration found
copper.jc_source: Johnson & Cook (1983/1985); copper JC parameters from literature survey (unverified exact fit)

alumina_Al2O3.label: Alumina Ceramic (Al₂O₃ — 99.5%)
alumina_Al2O3._note: JC approximation for brittle ceramic. JH2 model is more appropriate but JC is used here for unified framework. Parameters fitted to Lundberg et al. (2000) and Holmquist et al. (2002). A represents intact compressive strength; B≈0 since ceramics don't strain-harden; failure is brittle (fragmentation).
alumina_Al2O3.cs_source: Cowper & Symonds (1957); ceramic CS parameters estimated, no direct calibration
alumina_Al2O3.jc_source: Lundberg et al. (2000) & Holmquist & Johnson (2002) for alumina-like ceramics; adapted to JC form — UNVERIFIED

UHMWPE.label: Ultra-High-Molecular-Weight Polyethylene (Dyneema/Spectra)
UHMWPE._note: JC parameters for UHMWPE composite armor. Low A (polymer yield), high B and n (significant strain hardening from fiber alignment). High C because polymers are very rate-sensitive. Low T_melt (thermoplastic). Refs: Chocron et al. (2008), Russell et al. (2013).
UHMWPE.cs_source: Cowper & Symonds (1957); UHMWPE CS parameters estimated, no direct calibration found
UHMWPE.jc_source: Chocron et al. (2008) & Russell et al. (2013) — cited but exact parameter fit UNVERIFIED

constitutive_notes.rate_model_2: Experimental sensitivity blend only. No basis in standard constitutive literature.

source_definitions.verified: Parameter set traceable to cited paper(s) with confirmed values
source_definitions.UNVERIFIED: Cited paper exists but exact parameter values could not be verified without access to full text

confidence_definitions.high: Widely used in literature for this material, multiple independent sources
confidence_definitions.medium: Single source or derived from similar material
confidence_definitions.low: Estimated, interpolated, or from unverified citation
